outcome: Presence of natal or neonatal teeth
Complications related to natal or neonatal teeth
cohort: 12 infants with natal or neonatal teeth who reported to a dental center between 2012 and 2015
finding: Natal and neonatal teeth are an uncommon occurrence, and while they can cause anxiety for parents, most cases can be managed with extraction, leading to improved feeding and minimal complications.
mod_finding: Out of 12 cases, eight cases had a history of a physiologic delivery, while four were delivered by C-section.
